productConcept.name: Compendium
productConcept.tagline: The working memory of the archive
productConcept.description: A manuscript and document intelligence platform for archivists, special collections librarians, and rare document researchers — providing OCR transcription, editorial annotation, and edition tracking for historical manuscripts.
productConcept.rationale: The iron-folio design system signals editorial precision: Manrope headings at 0.06em tracking (monumental, measured), EB Garamond body (warm, historical, humanist), warm cream #f5f0e8 background (deliberate anti-default), near-black hero with deep navy accent. The concept_by_video.md cites letterpress, printed reference documents, ruled spreads, and scholars working with physical material. These signals point directly to a scholarly tools product for people who work with pre-digital text — not a French atelier or luxury brand (the obvious gravity well), but a precision platform for manuscript scholarship. Compendium honors every aesthetic signal without landing in generic territory.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion system has named keyframes (fade-in, slide-up, scroll-marquee), 0.75s standard duration (1.5× scaling applied), and concept_by_video.md explicitly describes GSAP ScrollTrigger scroll animations with parallax
